factorization_matrix_contract: The query-frame sum applies to minimal eight-term scalar factorizations of the current rank8 matrix B=R R^T/4. It also applies to decompositions whose nonzero query rows all lie in the retained Gram row space. A redundant factorization can use query rows outside that space that cancel. Such decompositions are not covered. Keeping only the same zero pattern is not sufficient.
scope: This covers every nonzero real or complex gather functional and every admissible nonsymmetric binary fitting C for the fixed E8 Gram pattern. A complex support contains the support of a nonzero real or imaginary part. The frame-rank sum becomes copy tax only if the private-copy interface is used. Redundant outside-rowspace query cancellation, productive source ownership, block labels, a rational central matrix with a different row space, a changed Gram support contract, and a new controller are outside this bound. No exponent improvement is claimed.
